A1.justification: Both PDFs describe the same JanusMesh work, with readable text, equations, figures and tables throughout. Neither supplied PDF contains an appendix; v1's reference to supplementary material supplies no additional local evidence.

before.justification: V1 reports original generation experiments, comparisons over 50 prompt pairs, component ablations and a 50-participant user study.

after.justification: V2 retains these original empirical results and adds a VSD baseline, a latent-space blending ablation and boundary-normal comparisons.

M1.justification: Sections 3.1–3.7 retain the same TRELLIS denoising, voxel/SDF fusion, noise guidance, CLIP orientation search, view-conditioned texturing and three-object extension. The added VSD and direct-latent variants are evaluation comparators.

E1.justification: Both versions use the same 60-object prompt pool across five categories, Objaverse 1.0 reference images, and two- and three-object illusion tasks. Additional ablation examples remain within this coverage.

E2.justification: V2 adds Shape from Semantics (VSD) alongside all four retained baselines in Table 1 and Figures 9–10. Direct Latent Averaging is also evaluated against the proposed fusion procedure in Figure 14.

E3.justification: Section 4.1 replaces the curvature-based Impact Factor with a triangle-connectivity Boundary Seam Score averaged over 50 pairs. This changes one evaluation endpoint; the retained sampling, rendering, generation settings and other metrics remain unchanged.

E4.justification: V2 adds a qualitative and six-metric latent-versus-voxel blending ablation (Figure 14), directly testing the central cross-space design beyond v1's comparisons among voxel fusion rules. It also adds boundary-normal analysis (Figure 11). The earlier guidance, texturing and orientation ablations remain.

E5.justification: Neither version reports repeated-seed experiments, confidence intervals, error bars or significance tests. The newly disclosed four prompt-pair sub-questions describe the user study, rather than a new uncertainty-reporting procedure.

E6.justification: V2 adds VSD results, including CLIP 27.523 and GPT accuracy 65%, and latent-blending results, including CLIP 22.47 and GPT accuracy 58%. Impact Factor entries are replaced by seam counts of 798.31 for JanusMesh and 1503.42 for Direct Concatenation. Retained benchmark scores and user-study percentages are unchanged; the new seam values use a different metric.

T1.justification: V1's custom Curvature Jump definitions and Boundary Avg/Global Avg ratio in Equation 7 are removed in favor of a connectivity-count definition. Method Equations 1–6 remain unchanged, and no theorem or proof is added.

C1.justification: The abstract, introductory contributions and conclusion retain the same claims about fast, training-free, textured 3D illusions, cross-space fusion, semantic separation and three-object scalability. The added experiments support these existing claims.

C2.justification: V2 interprets direct latent averaging as leaving TRELLIS's latent manifold and causing fragmentation. Its limitations newly state incompatibility with token-based generators such as Hunyuan3D and explain bat/Batman confusion, while retaining the three-object alignment limitation.

D1.justification: V2 newly discloses four prompt-pair sub-questions per user-study question, without establishing that the study changed. It removes v1's verbatim GPT evaluation prompt. Hardware, guidance parameters, denoising steps, stage timings and the project-page link remain documented.

R1.justification: V2 adds Hunyuan3D 2.0 in the applicability discussion and removes the FID and KID references by Heusel et al. and Bińkowski et al. The related-work narrative otherwise retains its coverage and positioning; ProlificDreamer was already cited in v1.

P1.justification: V2 condenses the rotational cases, metric explanations, results discussion and captions, and expands the limitations paragraph. It adds Taiwan to the affiliation and removes the acknowledgements. The main section order and method exposition remain stable.

P2.justification: Figures 9–10 are substantially reorganized into compressed six-method grids. V2 adds normal maps and the latent-blending figure with an embedded results table, removes the runtime table while retaining its information in prose, and changes margins and figure placement. Figure 9 also incorrectly labels the retained owl/hat row as sofa/book.

improvement.justification: The new quantitative latent-blending control and VSD comparison strengthen support for the central design and comparative claims, while expanded limitations clarify applicability. These gains outweigh localized losses from removing the exact GPT prompt and introducing a figure-label error. The improvement is limited: the new seam criterion ambiguously combines 'fewer than three neighbors' with 'deg=1', and the retained lowest-FID assertion still contradicts the tables.
